Q8387.reason: Beta-blockers ease angina by lowering myocardial O2 demand via reduced contractility and heart rate; they do not dilate coronaries, vasodilate peripherally, or block platelets.

Q8396.reason: Collective rights are held by a group as a group, rather than by its members as individuals; minority rights are not automatically collective, and individual member rights are a separate category.

Q8398.reason: Bandura’s sources of self-efficacy are mastery practice, similar-peer modeling, and positive feedback; avoiding tasks prevents mastery and would not be recommended.
